Requested ratios define block assignment fractions; ceil rounding, extended edge blocks, quality filtering, and buffers change patch/pixel fractions.
More than half the quality-eligible candidate pixels are excluded by the requested separation; unselected imagery and quality exclusions are reported separately.

Blocks are randomly assigned across a two-dimensional grid; whole patches are removed symmetrically only near a different active split. AOI edges, nodata/quality exclusions, and seams within the same split do not create buffers. Quantization and both-sided removal can produce a gap larger than requested.

The paired training comparison keeps buffered validation/test patches fixed. Its restored-training baseline still inherits the heldout side of the symmetric buffer; inspect its actual separation rather than assuming it fails the requested guard.
Optional class labels affect patch quality and seed coverage only; the continuous-field variogram is computed independently before label filtering.

source_metadata.label_caveat: ESA WorldCover 2021 is a weak, machine-generated annual reference rather than independent field ground truth. Its classifier uses Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2, so this demonstration measures agreement with WorldCover; it cannot establish true segmentation accuracy or prove that a buffer improves accuracy. Annual labels may differ from land cover visible on the single acquisition date.

explicit_differences: The caller supplies the spatial plan; its geometry and retention records are authoritative.
This bounded demo uses the supplied calibrated channels instead of requiring four seasonal 13-channel composites.
Three grouped model classes are supplied by the demo; the original WorldCover-to-group mapping is recorded in source_metadata.
Missing labels are int16 -100 instead of upstream uint8 255; missing feature values remain unchanged.
All retained patches are exported, with invalid pixels ignored rather than an additional post-plan patch quality exclusion.
Normalization sampling uses jointly finite training pixels; an empty Bernoulli draw falls back to one training pixel and is reported.
Validation and test membership are held fixed across the paired buffer conditions.
